item: A restore that meets a stuck settings lock refuses with its own fixed words instead of failing
summary: _carry_and_swap caught only KvWriteBusy around hold_writes, so a KvLockStuck (R144(b), #1446) surfaced as a failed restore. It now becomes RestoreRefused with fixed words (nothing written to the corpus, restart, import again), the same kind of refusal as a hold that cannot start; the carry and the swap never run. Tested with a real lock left owned by an ended thread, the restoring thread started before the owner ends so the ident cannot be reused; red without the change. Also pins that a refused second hold leaves the first hold's file size (the Retry-After figure of #1449) alone.
